Strictly enumerated boolean selection interface for truth-reading challenges; rejects arbitrary paths.
Worker evidence submission target holding submitted ordered seeds for challenge evaluation.
Source-specific provenance store tracking canonical source blob SHA and last-commit SHA for each reader.
Workflow-owned state recording challenge metadata and expected ordered seed vectors without leaking raw seeds outside authoritative files.
Persistent truth status indicator showing last challenge outcome, timestamp, and audited documents.
Workflow-only Node.js engine for canonical provenance tracking, complete array projection generation, seed injection, and zero-mutation/atomic verification.

files.content:
name: Truth Reader Verification

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.truth_reader/selector.json'
      - '.truth_reader/evidence.json'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  evaluate-truth:
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]') && github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Configure Git Author
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Inspect Trigger Commit
        id: trigger
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          echo "changed_files=${CHANGED_FILES}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q ".truth_reader/evidence.json"; then
            echo "phase=verify" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q ".truth_reader/selector.json"; then
            echo "phase=generate" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "phase=generate" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Execute Truth Challenge Generation
        if: steps.trigger.outputs.phase == 'generate'
        run: |
          node scripts/truth-reader-engine.js generate
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain .truth_reader)" ]; then
            git add .truth_reader
            git commit -m "truth-reader: dispatch active challenge [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi

      - name: Execute Truth Challenge Verification
        if: steps.trigger.outputs.phase == 'verify'
        run: |
          node scripts/truth-reader-engine.js verify
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain .truth_reader)" ]; then
            git add .truth_reader
            git commit -m "truth-reader: challenge PASS and atomic cleanup [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi

Seeds distributed across the active projection span the entire structural body of this document. Workers return all seeds in strict sequence.
